questions.question: Clarify the Computing Centre’s foundation year: the source gives 1956, while the centre’s own history gives 1955 and separately dates Strela’s installation to December 1956, https://rcc.msu.ru/en/rcc-history . Distinguish foundation from commissioning in both versions.

localizations.source: Clarify the Computing Centre’s foundation year: the source gives 1956, while the centre’s own history gives 1955 and separately dates Strela’s installation to December 1956, https://rcc.msu.ru/en/rcc-history . Distinguish foundation from commissioning in both versions.
localizations.ru: Уточнить год создания ВЦ МГУ: исходник даёт 1956, собственная история НИВЦ указывает 1955 и отдельно установку «Стрелы» в декабре 1956: https://rcc.msu.ru/en/rcc-history . Согласовать обе даты в RU/EN, не смешивая учреждение центра и запуск машины.

questions.resolution: The establishment of the centre and the installation of its first computer are dated separately according to the [MSU Research Computing Center](https://rcc.msu.ru/en/rcc-history).

questions.question: Check about three years before the move: the 1951 appointment and the 1953 opening suggest about two years. Approve the number or remove the approximate interval in both versions.

localizations.source: Check about three years before the move: the 1951 appointment and the 1953 opening suggest about two years. Approve the number or remove the approximate interval in both versions.
localizations.ru: Проверить «около трёх лет оставалось до переезда»: начало ректорства 1951 и открытие зданий 1953 дают около двух лет. Согласовать числительное или убрать приблизительный интервал в обеих версиях.

questions.resolution: The inaccurate estimate of the remaining construction time has been removed. The construction dates are retained.

questions.question: Clarify the evacuation route: the prepared version named Tashkent, whereas Moscow University’s chronicle places the evacuated part of the faculty in Ashkhabad and then Sverdlovsk, with its return to Moscow in May 1943.

localizations.source: Clarify the evacuation route: the prepared version named Tashkent, whereas Moscow University’s chronicle places the evacuated part of the faculty in Ashkhabad and then Sverdlovsk, with its return to Moscow in May 1943.
localizations.ru: Уточнить маршрут эвакуации: в подготовленной версии был назван Ташкент, тогда как летопись МГУ указывает эвакуацию части мехмата в Ашхабад, затем в Свердловск, и возвращение в Москву в мае 1943 года.

questions.resolution: The route now follows the [Moscow University chronicle](https://letopis.msu.ru/peoples/1380): Ashkhabad, then Sverdlovsk, with the return to Moscow in May 1943.
